configurable_props.name: tenantId
configurable_props.label: Tenant ID
configurable_props.description: Select an organization tenant to use, or provide a tenant ID

configurable_props.name: contactId
configurable_props.label: Contact ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the contact associated to the credit note

configurable_props.name: contactName
configurable_props.label: Contact Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the contact associated to the credit note. If there is no contact matching this name, a new contact is created.

configurable_props.name: contactNumber
configurable_props.label: Contact Number
configurable_props.description: Number of the contact associated to the credit note. If there is no contact matching this name, a new contact is created.

configurable_props.name: date
configurable_props.label: Date
configurable_props.description: The date the credit note is issued YYYY-MM-DD. If the Date element is not specified then it will default to the current date based on the timezone setting of the organisation

configurable_props.name: currencyCode
configurable_props.label: Currency Code
configurable_props.description: Currency used for the Credit Note

configurable_props.name: creditNoteNumber
configurable_props.label: Credit Note Number
configurable_props.description:
[ACCRECCREDIT](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/types#CreditNoteTypes) - Unique alpha numeric code identifying credit note ( *when missing will auto-generate from your Organisation Invoice Settings*)
[ACCPAYCREDIT](https://developer.xero.com/documentation/api/types#CreditNoteTypes) - non-unique alpha numeric code identifying credit note. This value will also display as Reference in the UI.

configurable_props.name: sentToContact
configurable_props.label: Sent to Contact
configurable_props.description: Boolean to indicate if a credit note has been sent to a contact via the Xero app (currently read only)

configurable_props.name: currencyRate
configurable_props.label: Currency Rate
configurable_props.description: The currency rate for a multicurrency invoice. If no rate is specified, the [XE.com day rate](http://help.xero.com/#CurrencySettings$Rates) is used
